name: light-box-switch
description: Light Box as one switch, as on the E-M10 and later bodies: the INFO key in single-picture playback goes to the Light Box display when the ▶ Info row Light Box (setting 257) is On, whatever setting 321 (▶ Close Up Mode, which has no menu row on the E-PM2) holds. CPlaySingleFrame::getJumpState 0x7ED09135 and its twin 0x7ED09616 test 257 = 1, 321 = 2 and check 0x7ED009D6 before they set display mode 11, the step before state 15 (ID_ST_DISP_LIGHTBOX_PREPARE); in both the `bne` of the 321 test becomes two `nop`. The state-15 step itself (0x7ED095E8) reads 257 and check 0x7ED00A1D only. 4 bytes, no new code. Needs data/specs/light-box-row-2.json for the row. See experiments/2026-11-19-light-box/NOTES.md, "Light Box as one switch".

ops._note: getJumpState 0x7ED09135: the `bne` after `cmp 2,d1` (setting 321, ▶ Close Up Mode, is mode2) -> two `nop`: Light Box On (setting 257 = 1) and check 1 (0x7ED009D6) decide alone

0x7ED09616, its twin, called by the zoom handlers: the `bne` after `cmp 2,d1` (setting 321, ▶ Close Up Mode, is mode2) -> two `nop`: Light Box On (setting 257 = 1) and check 1 (0x7ED009D6) decide alone
